answer: Through the bridge, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Admission rides on the trust graph: a newcomer's standing is bounded by the reputation of the agents that connect to it, and each link carries a hard per-epoch cap. Through the ember, clones cluster together with no honest links, and the graph itself marks them as a suspicious island with no reputable neighbours. That is the point of the gale: cloning stops paying the moment each copy costs as much as the original.
